versions.changelog:
Version 1.2.5

- No file changes detected in this release.
- Existing features and documentation remain unchanged.
v1.1.0: 修复SKILL.md格式，修复缺失脚本

Initial release of cn-report-generator.

- Automatically generates structured daily, weekly, and monthly reports from work logs.
- Supports report templates for 日报/周报/月报 in Chinese.
- Reads from MEMORY.md and daily logs for data extraction.
- Saves reports to designated directories for easy access.
- Designed to boost productivity and reduce manual reporting effort.
